translation:
A yellow coating is an interior pattern. In the initial disease of cold damage there is no such tongue. When it transmits to the shaoyang channel, there is also no such tongue. Only when it reaches the repletion of the yangming fu, and the fire in the stomach is exuberant, and fire rides the position of earth, is there therefore this coating. One should purge it according to the light and heavy [degree]. At first it is slightly yellow, next it is deep yellow with slipperiness, and in the extreme it is dry yellow and scorched yellow. Its symptoms include great heat, great thirst, constipation, delirious speech, glomus and oppression, and spontaneous diarrhea. Or because of loss of sweating there is yellowing, or there is blood accumulation with mania. These are all caused by damp-heat being too exuberant and urination being inhibited. If the whites of the eyes are like gold and the body is yellow like an orange, it is appropriate to use Yinchenhao tang (Oriental Wormwood Decoction), Wuling san (Five-Ingredient Powder with Poria), Zhizi Baipi tang (Gardenia and Phellodendron Decoction), and the like. If the blood accumulation is in the upper burner, [use] Xijiao Dihuang tang (Rhinoceros Horn and Rehmannia Decoction). In the middle burner, [use] Taoren Chengqi tang (Peach Kernel Order the Qi Decoction). In the lower burner, [use] Dai Didang tang (Substitute the Resist Decoction). In all blood patterns, when blood is seen, [the patient] is cured. One must absolutely not give cold water; if drunk, death is certain. In general, although a yellow-tongue pattern is severe, if the pulse is long, the qi of the middle earth is present. Purging it will bring ease. If the pulse is wiry with diarrhea, and the tongue coating is yellow with black in it, these are all dangerous patterns.

*純黃微干舌\pt108a30.bmp*

When a yellow coating is seen on the tongue, it is the extreme of stomach heat, the color of earth appearing at the tip of the tongue. One should urgently use Tiaowei Chengqi (Regulate-Stomach, Order-Qi) to purge it. If delayed, one fears the yellow will become old and turn black, becoming an ominous sign.

*微黃苔舌\pt108a31.bmp*

When the tongue is slightly yellow and not very dry, it is the exterior evil, having lost its sweating, first transmitting to the interior. Use Da Chaihu tang (Major Bupleurum Decoction). If both the body and the eyes are yellow, [use] Yinchenhao tang (Oriental Wormwood Decoction).

*黃干舌\pt108a32.bmp*

When the tongue shows dry yellow, the interior heat is already extreme. Purge urgently and do not delay. If after purging the pulse is still and the body is cool, there is life. If instead there is great heat with panting and a restless pulse, there is death.

*黃苔黑滑舌\pt108a33.bmp*

When the tongue is yellow with black slipperiness, the interior pattern of yangming is complete. Although it is not dry, one should still purge it. If after purging the body is cool and the pulse is still, there is life. If there is great heat and a restless pulse, there is death.

*黃苔黑斑舌\pt108a34.bmp*

When black spots grow in disorder within a yellow coating, its symptoms must be great thirst and delirious speech. If the body has no spots, use Da Chengqi (Major Order the Qi Decoction) to purge it. If the pulse is rough, with delirious speech, picking at the clothes and groping in the air, and the body is yellow with black spots, these are all not treated. If thin black stool is passed, there is death.

*黃苔中黑通尖舌\pt108a35.bmp*

When the yellow coating is black throughout from the middle to the tip, it is fire and earth being dry and the heat toxin being deepest. In double contraction cold damage, death is certain. In those with severe aversion to cold, death is also certain. If there is no aversion to cold, and the mouth is dry and the throat parched with diarrhea of foul water, one may use Tiaowei Chengqi tang (Regulate-Stomach, Order-Qi Decoction) to purge it. Four or five in ten may be saved. If the mouth is dry and the teeth are dry, with the form shedding, it is not treated.

*老黃隔瓣舌\pt108a36.bmp*

When the tongue is yellow, dry, and rough with separated petals, it is the evil heat entering the stomach, and the toxin binding already deep. If there is vexation-agitation and thirst, [use] Da Chengqi tang (Major Order the Qi Decoction). If there is yellowing, [use] Yinchenhao tang (Oriental Wormwood Decoction). If there is pain in the lower abdomen, there is static blood; [use] Didang tang (Resist Decoction). If there is chest binding, [use] Da Xianxiong tang (Major Chest Binding Decoction).

*黃尖舌\pt108a37.bmp*

When the coating of the tip of the tongue is yellow, the heat evil has first transmitted to the stomach fu. One should use Tiaowei Chengqi tang (Regulate-Stomach, Order-Qi Decoction). If the pulse is floating with aversion to cold, the exterior pattern is not exhausted; use Da Chaihu (Major Bupleurum) to resolve both.

*黃苔灰根舌\pt108a38.bmp*

When the root of the tongue is gray and the tip is yellow, although it is slightly lighter than a black root, if one or two more days pass, it will also become black. It is difficult to treat. If there is no vexation-agitation or staring straight ahead, and the pulse is sunken and forceful, treat it with Da Chaihu (Major Bupleurum) with additions and subtractions.

*黃尖紅根舌\pt108a39.bmp*

When the root is red and the tip is yellow, it is damp-heat riding the position of fire. In the initial disease of warm heat, there is often this tongue. Use Liangge (Cool the Diaphragm) and Jiedu (Detoxification) and such medicines, treating according to the circumstances.

*黃尖黑根舌\pt108a40.bmp*

When the black root of the tongue is much and the yellow tip is little, although there are no ominous symptoms or ominous pulses, one truly fears a sudden change in a moment, because the qi of the stomach is exhausted and cut off.

*黃苔黑刺舌\pt108a41.bmp*

When the coating of the tongue is extremely old yellow with black thorns in it, it is all caused by loss of sweating. The evil toxin has already sunk deep within. Urgently use Tiaowei Chengqi (Regulate-Stomach, Order-Qi) to purge it. One or two in ten may be preserved.

*黃大脹滿舌\pt108a42.bmp*

When the tongue is yellow and swollen large, it is the damp-heat of the yangming stomach channel. The symptoms must be body yellowing, constipation, and vexation-agitation. [Use] Yinchenhao tang (Oriental Wormwood Decoction). If the stool is spontaneously loose with yellowing, treat it with Wuling san (Five-Ingredient Powder with Poria) with Yinchen (Oriental wormwood), Zhizi (Gardenia), Huanglian (Coptis), and the like added.

*黃尖白根舌\pt108a43.bmp*

When the root of the tongue is white and the tip is yellow, the colors are seen inverted. It must be the shaoyang channel transmitting to the yangming fu disease. If the yangming pattern is more, [use] Da Chaihu tang (Major Bupleurum Decoction). If the shaoyang pattern is more, [use] Xiao Chaihu tang (Minor Bupleurum Decoction). If there is delirious speech and vexation-agitation, [use] Tiaowei Chengqi tang (Regulate-Stomach, Order-Qi Decoction).

*黃根白尖舌\pt108a44.bmp*

When the tip of the tongue is white and the root is yellow, it is the exterior evil being little and the interior evil being much. Use Tianshui san (Celestial Water Powder) and Liangge san (Cool the Diaphragm Powder) together. If yangming has no sweating, inhibited urination, and vexation and agitation in the heart, there must be yellowing. [Use] Yinchenhao tang (Oriental Wormwood Decoction).

*黃根灰尖舌\pt108a45.bmp*

The tongue is the position of fire. Now seeing a yellow root and gray tip is earth coming to insult fire. If there is no vomiting or diarrhea, with vexation in the heart and thirst, it is depressed heat in the stomach. [Use] Tiaowei Chengqi (Regulate-Stomach, Order-Qi) with Huanglian (Coptis) added.

*黃根白尖短縮舌\pt108a46.bmp*

When the tongue shows a yellow root and a white tip, short and hard, neither dry nor slippery, but unable to be extended out, the symptoms are mostly delirious and manic and chaotic. This is phlegm carrying retained food occupying the middle palace. Use Da Chengqi (Major Order the Qi Decoction) with ginger and pinellia added to govern it.
